title: NACA blade, ultra-fine mesh, single-threaded SPOOLES, AMD Ryzen 5 5600, Linux

code.note: eb39755 plus the CCX_SPOOLES_MT option of CMakeLists.txt (committed as 1125901, with a different default), configured OFF

command: python3 runner/run_benchmark.py --case naca_blade --level ultra_fine --solvers SPOOLES --threads 6 --bin SPOOLES=<build with CCX_SPOOLES_MT=OFF>/CalculiX
notes: Same machine, mesh and deck as 2026-11-24_ryzen5-5600_linux_ultra-fine, where SPOOLES was built multithreaded (USE_MT): 252.6 s and 24.3 GB there, 773.2 s and 13.3 GB here.
OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 still parallelises the rest of ccx; the SPOOLES factorisation itself runs on one thread.
Tip displacements agree with the multithreaded SPOOLES run of the same day to within 1e-10 (relative) and with MUMPS and PARDISO to within 1e-8.
The mesh files were copied from the earlier ultra-fine run, not regenerated.
